title: Standard Derivatives
summary: বীজগাণিতিক, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric ও inverse-trigonometric function-এর standard derivatives।
latex: \frac d{dx}x^n=nx^{n-1},\quad (e^x)'=e^x,\quad (\ln x)'=\frac1x,\quad (\sin x)'=\cos x,\quad (\cos x)'=-\sin x

derivation.lead: Derivative হলো instantaneous rate/ঢাল; standard limits থেকে মৌলিক সূত্রগুলো আসে।

steps.title: trigonometric
steps.latex: (\tan x)'=\sec^2x,\quad(\cot x)'=-\csc^2x,\quad(\sec x)'=\sec x\tan x,\quad(\csc x)'=-\csc x\cot x
steps.note: sin ও tan positive derivative; cos, cot, cosec negative—sec positive।

steps.title: general exponential/log
steps.note: a=e হলে ln e=1, তাই সহজ রূপ।

assumptions: Angle radian-এ; degree-তে derivative-এ π/180 factor লাগত।

memorize.trick: Trig derivative জোড়া: sin→cos, cos→−sin; tan→sec², cot→−cosec²; sec→sec tan, cosec→−cosec cot। Inverse-এ sin-এর 1−x², tan-এর 1+x²।
steps: Composite function দেখলেই chain rule-এ ভেতরের derivative গুণ করুন।
